mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing memantine levels, while both agents have mild antiplatelet and neuroprotective properties that could additively affect bleeding and CNS function.
action: Monitor for increased memantine side effects (dizziness, confusion) if turmeric supplementation is initiated; no dose adjustment typically required for occasional dietary turmeric use.
